question: Which statement best describes Static imports?
options: Build tools can follow static import and export statements to see which parts of a package are used. Dynamic runtime patterns may make that analysis harder.
Tree-shaking removes code that analysis shows is unused. Packages must expose modules in a way the tool can analyze, and some files have side effects that must remain.
Lazy loading delays noncritical work until it is needed. Add a useful loading state and avoid splitting tiny pieces into too many network requests.
Code splitting puts separate parts of an app into files that can load at different times. A route’s code can wait until someone visits that route.
explanation: Build tools can follow static import and export statements to see which parts of a package are used. Dynamic runtime patterns may make that analysis harder.
